description: Scrape Trustpilot business reviews, ratings, and replies across any business domain.

businessDomains.description: List of business domains as they appear on Trustpilot URLs (e.g. `amazon.com`, `airbnb.com`, `apple.com`). The domain is the part after `/review/` in the Trustpilot URL.
businessDomains.title: Business domains

containsKeyword.description: Only emit reviews whose title or body contains this substring (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Contains keyword

dateRangeFrom.description: Drop reviews older than this date.
dateRangeFrom.title: Date range from (YYYY-MM-DD)

dateRangeTo.description: Drop reviews newer than this date.
dateRangeTo.title: Date range to (YYYY-MM-DD)

language.description: Limit reviews to a specific language code (e.g. `en` for English, `de` for German). Leave empty for all languages.
language.title: Language filter

maxItems.description: Hard cap on total emitted records across all businesses.
maxItems.title: Global max items

maxRating.description: Drop reviews with a rating above this value.
maxRating.title: Max rating (1-5)

maxReviewsPerBusiness.description: Hard cap on reviews fetched per business domain (mode=reviews). Trustpilot shows 20 reviews per page; this paginates.
maxReviewsPerBusiness.title: Max reviews per business

minRating.description: Drop reviews with a rating below this value.
minRating.title: Min rating (1-5)

mode.description: What to emit. `reviews` returns one record per review (default). `summary` returns one record per business with TrustScore, total reviews, and rating distribution.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential proxy is REQUIRED for Trustpilot — datacenter IPs are blocked by AWS WAF.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

responseRequired.description: Only emit reviews that received a reply from the business.
responseRequired.title: Has business reply

verifiedOnly.description: Only emit reviews flagged as verified.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified only

title: Trustpilot Reviews Scraper Input
